name: Caldera Circuit
description: Race the ring road around an active volcanic caldera on Stella Island. The lava lake in the center is impassable — navigate the coastal circuit to visit all 10 scenic overlooks before your battery dies.

messages.welcome: Welcome to Stella Island! The volcano is active — race the ring road and visit all 10 overlooks!
messages.victory: Island circuit complete! All %d overlooks visited!
messages.out_of_battery: Stranded on the caldera road! Game Over!
messages.stranded: Battery dead on the ring road! Game Over!
messages.cant_move: Lava or jungle — no way through!
messages.hit_wall: You drove into the lava! Game Over!
